command: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs";import{sha256,taskContractDigest}from"./scripts/remediation/board.mjs";const d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("docs/remediation/tracker.json")),t=d.tasks.find(t=>t.id==="W09.01"),b=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("docs/remediation/design/W09.01/baseline.json")),a=d.authority.local_authorization,x=a.scope_extensions.find(e=>e.scope_task_ids.includes(t.id)),s=d.journal.find(e=>e.task_id===t.id&&e.to==="in_progress");if(t.state!=="in_progress"||d.tasks.filter(t=>["in_progress","verification"].includes(t.state)).length!==1||!a.scope_task_ids.includes(t.id)||a.scope_package_ids.includes("W09")||d.authority.deployment!==false||!x||Date.parse(x.at)>Date.parse(s.at)||sha256(fs.readFileSync(x.record.path))!==x.record.sha256||sha256(fs.readFileSync(t.preflight.plan.path))!==t.preflight.plan.sha256||taskContractDigest(t)!==t.preflight.contract_digest||s.plan_sha256!==t.preflight.plan.sha256)throw Error("Contract/authority/start");for(const p of b.pins)if(sha256(fs.readFileSync(p.path))!==p.sha256)throw Error("Pin "+p.path);for(const task of d.tasks.filter(t=>t.state==="closed"))for(const f of task.artifact.files)if(sha256(fs.readFileSync(f.path))!==f.sha256)throw Error("Accepted drift "+f.path);console.log(JSON.stringify({ok:true,task:t.id,journal:d.journal.length,contract:t.preflight.contract_digest,plan:t.preflight.plan.sha256,start:s.at,scope_extension:x.at,pins:b.pins.length,protected:b.pins.length-b.owned.length,closed:d.tasks.filter(t=>t.state==="closed").map(t=>t.id)}));'
source_scope: Four admitted files only plus worker.json; exact approved plan. Full W09, durable recovery and external authority excluded.
